title: pressure-2 definitions of the derivative result export 0.3
description: pressure-2 (3.0.0/exact_pressure_v3: straight pipe, realized arcs and objective connectors): ResultEnvelope's pressure-2 branch, result sets and contract evidence, referenced by results.v0.3.schema.yaml and stress_neutral_export.v0.3.schema.json and kept apart so that readers of the other semantics do not embed them.

items.description: The member's case section (results.v0.3 PhysicsGeometry, D-5) and its traversal flag; a realized arc adds its kind and end tangents and is always Euler-Bernoulli.

PressureRegion.description: pressure-2 (3.0.0/exact_pressure_v3) pressure region. A region with a realized arc carries the arc keys and the arc approximation; its arc members carry member_kind and their end tangents and the bend-term applied-load record. Closed shape only; cross-binding (traversal, junction tangents, withheld rows, RHS terms) is executable reader validation.

PressureResolvedPipeMaterial.description: pressure-2 resolved per-member material under the load/reference-state group: the same closed shape as load_reference_state.schema.json LoadReferencePipeMaterial, held locally so closed-shape checkers resolve it in this file.

PressureExactCase.description: pressure-2 exact case: the base common E/nu materials, or resolved per-member materials under the load/reference-state group. The RHS terms add the bend's removed caps and the junction remainder.

PressureExactEquivalentStatic.description: W-16 slice c (DEL-05-01 Design exact-equivalent-static.md section 2): present exactly on a case with equivalent_static generation; the route's D-5 mass method and the ids of the generated primitives, in generation order.

PressureConnectorRecord.description: One objective connector record (T4-U3, JR section 7). Closed shape only; row binding is executable reader validation.

tie_rods.description: T4-U5b (DEL-04-07 Design u4b-u5b-implementation.md section 3.3): one entry per explicit elastic tie rod, in authored order. Closed shape only; uniqueness, the axial share and row binding are executable reader validation.

PressureContractEvidence.description: Raw producer contract_evidence for pressure-2 (3.0.0/exact_pressure_v3): pressure regions including realized arcs, connector records and exact cases; a model carrying the load/reference-state group also publishes load_reference_states (load_reference_state.schema.json LoadReferenceStateRecord). Carriers preserve it verbatim. Closed shape only; cross-binding is executable reader validation.

PressureResultMetadata.description: Canonical metadata under the pressure-2 vocabulary: the exact straight-member vocabulary plus the objective connector rows' components, frame (connector_axes_q), location (connector_local) and stable basis; other identities keep ResultMetadata.

representation.const: B: p(Ae - Ai) at the attachments; joint_effective_area + joint_face_cap

ComponentBodyRecord.description: W-15 slice d (DEL-03-05 Design rigid-component-stiffness-scaling.md section 5): present only on a component body's stress row, stress extremum and maximum, and on their derivative quantities and source annotations. The row is a stress of the mapped pipe section, a reference section, not of the component body.
